prompt: Generate a 'picture-in-picture' image with visual depth. The outermost layer is a realistic VSCode programming interface, nested with a Qwen App chat interface. In the chat, I am sending a message saying: 'help me generate a hand-brewed coffee poster'. The app replies with an exquisite coffee poster, which is also clearly displayed in the chat interface. Each UI layer must maintain realistic style and detail, with clear micro-details like time digits and button text.

promptZh: 生成一张具有视觉深度的“画中画”图像。最外层是一个逼真的 VSCode 编程界面，其中嵌套了一个 Qwen App 聊天界面。在聊天中，我发送了一条消息：“帮我生成一张手冲咖啡海报”。该应用回复了一张精美的咖啡海报，海报也清晰地显示在聊天界面中。每个 UI 层级都必须保持逼真的风格和细节，并呈现出如时间数字和按钮文字等清晰的微小细节。
